evidence.explanation: The study evaluates legacy GPT-3 models and GPT-4 under aligned settings across more than twenty benchmarks and seven capability categories. Its overall analysis reports broad improvements across those categories from GPT-3 to GPT-4.

OpenAI's comparison finds strong preferences for o1-preview on reasoning-heavy tasks but exceptions on natural-language tasks. This directly supports the claimed unevenness, while the same publication documents substantial reasoning gains.

Independent testing found improvements on an abstract-reasoning benchmark as well. This limits any reading that o1's benefits were confined to the particular math and coding examples, but does not establish uniform gains.
